prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Preset customization fallback flow (+8.0%), interactive wait screen tips (+5.1%), story screen sequence reordering (+2.9%), and existing account retrieval sign-in hints (+6.0%) were helpful.
Most wait screen updates (progress bars, alerts, timers), sign-in step reordering, layout changes, and visual redesigns showed no clear effect.
Specific copy changes (-13.9%, -7.7%) and new desktop screens (-9.9%) significantly hurt performance.
Sign-in hints can be helpful (+6.0%), updating the previous trend where sign-in changes had no clear effect.
Predictions consistently overestimated positive impacts, but underestimated wins like story sequence reordering (predicted -1.0%, measured +2.9%) and account retrieval hints (predicted +1.0%, measured +6.0%).

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, copy: -1.2% over 2 test(s)
- adoption, new_flow: +5.7% over 2 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: -3.8% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, redesign: -1.0% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, reorder: +2.9% over 1 test(s)
- finish, copy: -4.0% over 2 test(s)
- finish, layout: +1.4% over 2 test(s)
- finish, new_screen: -7.8% over 2 test(s)
- home, new_flow: -2.0% over 1 test(s)
- home, new_screen: +3.0% over 1 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +2.0% over 4 test(s)
- sign_in, hint: +3.1% over 2 test(s)
- sign_in, layout: -0.0% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: -1.3% over 1 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 79.1%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 77.5%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 62.7%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 85.0%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 21.2%

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Character Preview Carousel Redesign: Redesign the pet selection screen into a dynamic visual carousel layout with active character preview components. (why: Adoption has a heavy drop-off with 62.7% conversion and custom pet generation failures occur, making character previews crucial.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Placement Launch Helper Screen: Add a new screen right before completion demonstrating where the pet lands on screen and how to wake it. (why: 3 support tickets reported pet not showing on desktop or failing to open, causing drop-offs on the final finish step (64.8%).)
2: [adoption, new_flow] Fallback Preset Recovery Selection Flow: Introduce a dedicated instant preset recovery flow for users encountering custom photo generation issues. (why: Support mails highlight custom pet generation failing or looking wrong, contributing to the low adoption conversion rate (62.7%).)
3: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Path Sign-In Sequence Shift: Move sign-in screen to take place right after completing adoption details rather than before pet selection. (why: Signing in before choosing a pet creates friction early (77.5% conversion), while building emotional connection first improves sign-in completion.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Multi-Device Sync Warning Hint: Add an explicit hint on the sign-in screen explaining account reuse to prevent lost pets. (why: 8 support emails were received about pets missing or reset after signing in with a different account.)
5: [finish, copy] Desktop Overlay Activation Callout Copy: Update the home screen introduction headline and body copy to explain exact desktop interaction hotkeys. (why: 3 support messages showed user confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet once onboarding finishes.)
6: [home, wait_info] Background Rendering Desktop Ready Tip: Display helpful tips on system tray setup and desktop visibility during the rendering wait screen. (why: The wait screen has a high median wait (201s) and high mean (2336s), plus users reported missing desktop icons.)
7: [choose_path, layout] Split Card Journey Path Layout: Change choose_path screen layout to a visual split comparison card style. (why: The choose_path stage has a high mean duration (514s), indicating hesitation when selecting custom vs preset options.)
8: [home, notification] Background Render Task Notification Opt-In: Enable background desktop notification alerts when generation finishes on the wait screen. (why: Home wait stage takes a mean of 2336s, causing drop-offs if users step away without background completion alerts.)

scores.note: Visual redesigns and character carousels historically perform poorly or hurt conversion.
Adding new screens to the finish step significantly hurts onboarding performance.
Preset fallback flows directly address low adoption conversion and have a proven strong uplift track record.
Reordering the sign-in step has shown no clear benefit and slightly negative lift in historical tests.
Account retrieval and sync hints consistently deliver positive conversion gains when backed by support tickets.
Explicit copy changes have consistently underperformed or significantly reduced conversion.
Adding informative tips during lengthy wait screens reliably improves step completion.
Layout adjustments and card re-arrangements on path selection have shown negative or neutral impact.
Wait screen alerts and opt-in prompts have shown no clear positive effect in prior iterations.
